title: Collections Timetable and Charges for the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement
content:
**Collections timetable — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.** Day counts in this timetable are calendar days after the due date of the oldest unpaid period (for the gate lockout and the notice of intent to tow) or after the tow notice (for the earliest tow). The tow notice fee shown is the tow notice fee of the space class; the returned-payment fee is charged for a payment returned unpaid for insufficient funds or a closed account.

| Space class | Gate code suspended | Notice of intent to tow may be sent | Tow notice fee of the class | Earliest tow after the notice | Returned-payment fee |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | day 10 | day 30 | $40.00 | 15 days | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | day 10 | day 30 | $50.00 | 15 days | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | day 10 | day 30 | $50.00 | 15 days | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | day 10 | day 30 | $50.00 | 15 days | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | day 10 | day 30 | $50.00 | 15 days | $30.00 |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | day 12 | day 35 | $50.00 | 21 days | $35.00 |

**Payment acceptance and towing charges (all classes).**

| Space class | Payment below the balance while delinquent | Payment below the balance after the notice of intent to tow | Towing company's own towing and storage charges |
|---|---|---|---|
| Every class listed above | Accepted | Not accepted | Paid by the tenant directly to the towing company |

**Reading the timetable.** The Bluegate Uncovered Car Space is the one class with a $40.00 tow notice fee; the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage runs on a longer timetable (gate code suspended at day 12, tow notice from day 35, earliest tow 21 days after the notice) and carries a $35.00 returned-payment fee against $30.00 elsewhere. Hypothetical illustration: for a Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) whose oldest unpaid period fell due on 1 June, day 10 is 11 June and day 30 is 1 July.
